svg.aria-label: Request flow. Real MetroPT-3 sensor data and seeded device rows feed device adapters. A LangGraph workflow plans with the rule planner or an optional LLM planner, then calls three registry tools: get device status, query alarm code and search the maintenance manual. The answer is rendered from tool evidence with provenance. FastAPI serves POST /agent/invoke, GET /health and GET /metrics. An observability layer records structured logs, Prometheus metrics and optional traces.
svg.title: Industrial Maintenance Agent - request flow
